d: Mokama ki rajniti men aakhir aisa kya huaa ki anant sinh ke parivar ki narajgi ab khulkar samne aane lagi hai.... kya jediyu se chhah sal ke lie nishkasan aur ab suprim kort ke sakht aadesh ne anant sinh kheme ki mushkilen barha di hain.... ya phir is pure ghatnakram ke pichhe bihar ki badalti siyasat ka koee bara sandesh chhipa hai.... in savalon ke bich anant sinh ke bete abhishek sinh ki ek phesbuk post ne rajnitik galiyaron men halchal macha di hai....abhishek sinh ne apni post men nyay ke taraju ki tasvir lagaee aur ek aisi bat likhi, jisne sabka dhyan khinch liya.... unhonne likha…
